prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: rebuild cost after an extension. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 1)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"If you add an extension, you must tell us as soon as the work is complete and before any future claim.
